name.en-US: The Book of the Twelve Béguines

description.dum: Ruusbroecs laatste en omvangrijkste werk: twaalf beguinen bespreken de liefde tot Christus, met uitwijding over de hemel, de planeten, de Kerk en het lijden van Christus. Middelnederlandse tekst van J. B. David (1863); de hoofdstuktitels zijn Latijn (naar Surius).
description.en-US: Ruusbroec's last and longest work: twelve béguines discuss love of Christ, with digressions on the heavens, the planets, the Church and Christ's Passion. The Middle Dutch text of J. B. David (1863); the chapter titles are Latin (after Surius).
description.pt-BR: A última e mais extensa obra de Ruusbroec: doze beguinas conversam sobre o amor a Cristo, com digressões sobre os céus, os planetas, a Igreja e a Paixão. Texto em neerlandês médio de J. B. David (1863); os títulos dos capítulos são em latim (segundo Surius).

sources.edition: Jan van Ruusbroec, Werken, ed. J. B. David, deel 5: Dat boec vanden twaelf beghinen. (Gent: Maetschappy der Vlaemsche Bibliophilen, 1863).
sources.description: Keyed text from DBNL (TEI XML, 'auteursrechtvrij'), converted by research/sourcing/_scripts/rhineland/ruus_build.py. Line-end hyphens joined; page and line breaks dropped. David's apparatus is kept as footnotes (manuscript variants F, G, I, L, M, D, Surius' Latin readings 'Sur.'). David's Dutch preface, manuscript list, misprint list and glossary are not included.
sources.tierEvidence: Nineteenth-century critical edition, marked 'Auteursrechtvrij' on DBNL.
